name: Reporting Waiver Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the type of regulatory reporting pre-trade waiver.

ILQD.name: Illiquid Instrument Transaction
ILQD.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for an illiquid instrument transaction. Applicable to non-equity instruments.

SIZE.name: Above Specific Size Transaction
SIZE.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for an above specific size transaction. Applicable to non-equity instruments.

RPRI.name: Transaction With Price Improvment
RPRI.definition: Transactions which have received price improvement. Applicable to equity instruments.

LRGS.name: Large In Scale
LRGS.definition: Large-in-scale transactions. Applicable for all instruments.

TNCP.name: Transaction Not Contributing To Price Discovery
TNCP.definition: Transactions not contributing to the price discovery process.

XFPH.name: Exchange For Physical
XFPH.definition: Transaction where the contract on a commodity is exchanged for the actual physical good.
